commentary.claim: Flags the Dec 2025 Stock-Based Compensation Expense spike (about 334,661) as a possible one-off / single-month item.
commentary.evidence: Says Dec 2025 "appears to include single-month items" and cites "Stock-Based Compensation Expense of 334,661" against a typical 0, matching the reference 334,660.53.

commentary.claim: Flags the Dec 2025 Bonus spike (about 80,343) as a possible one-off / single-month item.
commentary.evidence: Cites "Bonus of 80,343, against typical months of 0 and 2,721" in the same single-month-items sentence; this matches the reference 80,342.53 and median 2,720.83.

commentary.claim: Leaves the one-off determination to the reviewer (hedged wording such as 'appears to be' or 'reviewer to confirm') rather than concluding.
commentary.evidence: Uses hedged wording: "appears to include single-month items; reviewer to confirm." It does not reach a conclusion.

commentary.claim: States as unhedged fact that these Dec 2025 items are non-recurring/one-off.
commentary.evidence: The one-off characterisation is hedged ("appears to include single-month items; reviewer to confirm"). It is never stated as unhedged fact.

commentary.claim: Asserts an accounting treatment or a cause for these items as fact (e.g. 'year-end bonus accrual', 'option vesting', 'should be excluded/normalised').
commentary.evidence: The commentary gives no cause or accounting treatment for SBC or Bonus, and no "accrual", "vesting" or "should be excluded" language. The Income Tax Benefit is described only as the reason the month was positive, and the Bad Debts credit is explicitly left for the reviewer.
